summary: I-have-ADHD is a Python library that adds a safeguard to LLM‑powered coding agents, preventing them from burying answers inside generated code blocks. It ships as a CLI and a Python API built on a pure‑Python stack with no external API keys required. The tool is aimed at developers who run autonomous coding agents and need reliable answer extraction. Its standout strength is the massive community backing (32,910 stars) and extremely fast import time, while the main caveat is that functional tests currently fail, indicating incomplete reliability.
